odc_type: Missing feature support for file format signature
observation_summary: The application throws a 'No Compressor found for the stream signature' exception when attempting to process a deflate-compressed file that contains a zlib header.
reasoning_summary: The system failed to detect and decompress deflate streams that included a zlib header. The CompressorStreamFactory lacked the logic to identify the specific byte signature associated with zlib-compressed data. The fix involved implementing a 'matches' method in the DeflateCompressorInputStream class to identify the zlib header bytes and updating the CompressorStreamFactory to utilize this detection logic during the stream creation process.
